title: Very useful except Checkbox propert
body:
Very useful note taking app. It can let you to determine a tag for your notes. Set a reminder for definite time or place. Especially setting an alarm for a specific place is very useful since all of people have lots of to do list that are specific to belonging in definite location.

However checkboxes are not enough useful. These are two big deficiencies which I observed:

1. When we take a not there is two option : taking a note on a blank page or with checkboxes. But I want to write some notes without checkboxes and then related to explanation that I wrote on top my note I can prefer add checkboxes. But application does not allow this.

2. I want to check my daily chain activites. Then I want to tick stuffs I did and leave empty rest. In addition to that every day my checklist comes to me like without arrangements as empty ticking. Lastly there can be weekly report of my chain todo list. Why I expect this by you that I like googleKeep because it allows us to do lots of stuffs in one single application without need another ones. However these two features are missed from the eyes and they can be very attributive.
